notes: US thermal POS receipt. Contains TWO dates: 5/24/2025 11:47:32 AM is the transaction; 11/20/2019 11:09 AM is the card terminal date/time and must NOT be selected. Tesseract renders decimals as commas ($29 ,99 / $2,51 / $32,50) so numeric normalisation is required. Sales tax, not VAT - no TIN exists on US receipts. ITEMS: this is ONE purchase across two printed lines - '1 Family bundle--10pcs' priced at 29.99, with 'Chickenjoy bucket + 3 large sides' as an unpriced description beneath it. The correct output is a single row with quantity 1 (the receipt's own quantity column) and the description folded into the name. '10pcs' describes the bundle contents and must not be read as a quantity: 10 x 29.99 would overstate the line tenfold.

expected_items.name: Family bundle--10pcs Chickenjoy bucket + 3 large sides
